_comment: Native `--format json` baseline digest for the axilog-cli facade regression guard (M17 Task 3). See facade_identity.rs for the regeneration procedure. Regenerated for the healing-extension roster change: `blocks.healing` gained an `extension` descriptor (version/revision/signature, decoded from the addon's registration row) and every `blocks.healing.by_entity` row gained `runs_extension` — GW2EI's `RunningExtension` roster, which the native format previously did not carry at all, leaving EI-shaped consumers unable to tell 'this player's healing numbers are complete' from 'partial, relayed by a peer'. Both are intentional new fields, so byteLength grew by 1563 from the pre-roster baseline. Re-digested (byteLength unchanged) for the 1.2.0 version bump: the document embeds `axilog.version`, so every release bump moves this digest by exactly that string. Determinism verified at each regeneration: two independent captures produced byte-identical output and identical sha256 digests. Regenerated for `blocks.self_effects`: the squad-side counterpart to `blocks.conditions`, carrying per-(squad player, effect) uptime and a fused stack timeline for the 14 conditions plus Stun (872) and Daze (833). It is a new opt-in block gated on the existing `--timeseries` flag, which `--all` turns on, so byteLength grew by 248477. Determinism verified: two independent captures of the new output were byte-identical with identical sha256 digests. Re-digested for the `blocks.self_effects` all-zero drop-rule fix: the pass previously emitted a row for a zero-length buff application, whose fused timeline is `[[0, 0], [t, 0]]` -- two entries, so it slipped past the old `len() < 2` guard -- carrying no information, and in one case an `avg_stacks: 0.0` the schema's own convention says should be omitted rather than reported. The guard now tests for a nonzero stack value, dropping exactly those rows: 345 self_effects rows became 343 (entity 22 buff 738 and entity 34 buff 26766 removed), so byteLength shrank by 521. Elite Insights omits such a buff from `buffUptimes` entirely, and the EI equality oracle is unchanged by this (476 cells, worst duration 0.000500pp, worst intensity 0.000497rel, before and after) because it never compared those keys. Determinism verified: two independent captures were byte-identical with identical sha256 digests. Re-digested (byteLength unchanged at 8499154) for the 1.3.0 version bump: the document embeds `axilog.version`, so every release bump moves this digest by exactly that string. Determinism verified: two independent captures were byte-identical with identical sha256 digests.
